preconditions.description: Attacker must have a valid EIP-712 permit signature from a token holder on another chain (e.g., Ethereum mainnet)
The DOMAIN_SEPARATOR must be identical across chains due to missing chainId in its calculation

exploit_hint: Obtain a valid EIP-712 permit signature from a token holder on another chain (e.g., Ethereum). Replay the same signature on BSC chain to bypass the nonce check and gain unauthorized token allowances. The DOMAIN_SEPARATOR is identical across chains because it uses chainid() at construction time but doesn't include it in the domain separator calculation, making signatures valid on multiple chains.
